title: The HeartBank Institutional Corpus
description:
White papers and position papers published by HeartBank(R) — the institution's stated positions on gratitude infrastructure, dual-currency reciprocity, gift/exchange boundaries, AI succession and institutional governance.

Scope note: this corpus is deposited selectively. Documents that make a claim someone could cite and build on are deposited; documents that state what the institution will do — commitments, annual reports, press — are not. A position carries a DOI only when it is an argued contribution.

AI co-authorship is disclosed. Miss Aquarius is the consistent name used for the AI collaboration across all venues.
